What does that prove?","literal_explanation":"Previously trusted access stops being reliable evidence of legitimate action when an attacker can reuse an accepted credential or originate requests through an accepted infrastructure path, and the receiving system accepts that access without independently establishing authorization for the specific action. An access signal can remain valid after control of its use has changed. This is a bounded inference, not evidence that every trusted path is compromised or that compromised access permits unrestricted action.","reported_facts":[{"text":"Cloudflare reports that one service token and three accounts associated with stolen credentials were left unrotated and later used by attackers to access its Atlassian environment.
